The details

Product description

Two nesting tables in premium teak, each 20mm top set with a pearl green resin inlay. Use them together for a layered look, or apart in the living room, bedroom or lounge, and nest them when you need the floor back.

FAQ

Before you order

Can't find your question? Ask us on WhatsApp

Is it real wood?
Yes. The tops are teak wood, 20mm thick, with pearl green resin set into the grain. You can see the natural grain in every photo on this page.
Will my set look exactly like the photos?
The shape, colours and sizes will match. The grain and the flow of the resin will differ a little, because each top is made by hand. No two sets are the same.
Will it fit beside my sofa?
The large table is 14 in (35.5 cm) wide and 19 in (48 cm) tall, about 2 in above a typical sofa seat. The small table is 12 in (30.5 cm) wide and 16.5 in (42 cm) tall. See them drawn to scale
When will it reach me?
We dispatch in 1-2 business days. After that it takes 3-5 business days to Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai and Kolkata, 5-7 to tier 2 cities and towns, and up to 10 to remote locations. Delivery is free on this order, and you get a tracking ID by email or SMS when it ships. Enter your pincode near the price for a date.
What if it arrives damaged?
Take photos within 48 hours of delivery, then email support@wewood.co.in within 7 days with your order number and the photos. We will arrange a replacement or exchange.
Do you ship outside India?
Not yet. We currently deliver only within India.
Can I return it if I change my mind?
No. We exchange pieces that arrive damaged or defective, but we don't offer returns or refunds for other reasons. If you're unsure about size or finish, message us on WhatsApp before you order.
Can I pay on delivery, or in EMIs?
Yes to both. Cash on delivery is available, and you can also pay by UPI, wallets, cards or EMI from 15+ banks.

Will it fit?

Both tables drawn to scale, beside a typical sofa.

Show sizes in
  • Sofa-side height. The large table's top sits 2 in above a typical sofa seat, so your chai is within easy reach.
  • Measure your sofa arm. Most sit around 25 in, so the tables tuck in just below it.
  • Picture an A4 sheet. The small table's top is about as wide as an A4 sheet is long.
  • Short on floor space? Keep them nested day to day and pull the small one out when you need it.
